canonical_user_job: Complete and maintain the authorised client's health and medical profile, including GP details, allergies, disabilities, histories and notes, within the client profile workflow.
basis: The client completion/edit wizard is a live human surface that hydrates, validates and persists ClientMedicalProfile through ClientController. The dedicated /clients/{client}/medical URLs are compatibility redirects to eMAR, but they are not the only Clients surface.

aliases_and_read_lenses.surface: PUT client medical profile compatibility routes

emar_api_disposition.mapping_rule: Remove the RUN-020 API edge to CAP-MED-CLIENT-MEDICAL-PROFILE. Retain the allergy API anchors as component and transport evidence under the existing CAP-MED-EMAR-WORKSPACE-ORDER-LIFECYCLE edge.
emar_api_disposition.reason: The API endpoints operate on MedicationAllergy, a separate record store from ClientMedicalProfile. The GET is embedded only as an allergy safety lookup in the Add Medication flow; no source-visible UI caller or dedicated test was found for POST. Do not create another canonical feature from this inspection.
emar_api_disposition.dual_record_store_warning: ClientMedicalProfile.allergies and MedicationAllergy are distinct stores; do not merge their ownership merely because both represent allergy information.
authority_and_test_gaps: GET and POST use different route permissions and Client policy actions.
No source-visible frontend caller or dedicated route test was found for the POST allergy endpoint.

evidence_limit: Static pinned-source identity and owner arbitration only; no runtime, browser, test-execution, benchmark, ease, release, production-readiness, or audit-completion credit.
